title: Revamp HTML validation error popup
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

For some input fields (e.g. `st.number_input`), we show the normal HTML form error when validation fails (e.g. if the number is outside the min/max boundaries):

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/92b709e7-4e87-48b4-a83b-f64ab45d6305)

This error doesn't follow our styling though and also doesn't get formatted by theming. We should change it to our own error popup, e.g. similar to the one we made for validation in `st.date_input`:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/822db4aa-d5b8-4a6d-aa38-fe9c836d24d4)

### Why?

_No response_

### How?

_No response_

### Additional Context

_No response_
